review: Ranking mechanisms need worked score calculations, query-intent slices, and multilingual evaluation rather than only names of algorithms.
build: Build a labeled set with exact identifiers, paraphrases, typos, multilingual questions, and unanswerable requests. Compare lexical, dense, and fused rankings. Trace exact lexical and toy dense retrieval through reciprocal-rank fusion to a cited extractive response; swap owner and remove evidence to explain abstention.
verify: Report per-slice Recall@K and ranking examples. Apply trusted filters before publishing candidates and retain original ranks for diagnosis. Run `python3 -B labs/grounded_policy_pipeline.py`; independently compute Recall@k and MRR on the authored fixture. This does not evaluate a real embedding model or generative LLM.
